title: Verdicts
description: One lens's review of one slice: a verdict with evidence for every acceptance criterion and every check of the lens. `factory.slices/v1.findings` refuses a set that misses an id.

id.description: an acceptance criterion id (A-n) or a lens check id (L-n)

evidence.description: file:line, the command and its output, or the quoted text

suggestion.description: the concrete change a fix round should make
